mcqs.question: A 'dinner fork' deformity of the distal forearm resulting from a fall on an outstretched hand is caused by:
mcqs.explanation: Colles fracture is an extra-articular fracture of the distal radial metaphyseal region with dorsal displacement, dorsal tilt, and radial shift producing the classic dinner fork appearance.
